uncallable.title: Types and interfaces
uncallable.body: The index resolves calls, and a type is annotated rather than called — so "no callers" says nothing about these. They are listed here because they did change.

noDownstream: {count} changed symbol(s), no downstream callers found.

empty.title: No downstream impact found
empty.degradedTitle: No callers found — but the index is incomplete
empty.degradedBody: The code index could not be read in full, so an empty result here does not mean this change is contained. Re-index the repository and check again.

partial.title: This list may be incomplete
partial.body: Some files could not be indexed, so callers in them are missing from this list. Treat these counts as a lower bound.

degraded.title: The code index is stale or unavailable
degraded.body: Do not read this as a complete impact list. Re-index the repository from its Project Context page, then reopen this tab.

error.title: Couldn't load the blast radius
error.body: The blast radius for this pull request could not be computed.

symbol.noCallers: No callers found for this symbol.
symbol.unknownCallers: The index could not resolve callers for this symbol. Absent here means unknown, not none.
symbol.unreferencedBody: Nothing in the index mentions this name — it is new, or nothing uses it.
symbol.unresolvedBody: Mentioned {count} time(s), but no mention could be tied to this declaration. That happens when the calling file receives this through an injected port and so does not import it — the import graph cannot prove a link that may well exist. Worth checking by hand.

priorPrs.title: Prior PRs touching these files
priorPrs.empty: No merged pull requests have touched these files.
